ns2:section.sectionText: Focused on the application of geological sciences to engineering practice, this course covers topics such as site investigations, slope stability, and geological considerations in construction and infrastructure development. It prepares students to address geotechnical challenges encountered in engineering projects. Standard Letter Graded.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Environ Geology ONL-UIUC, NDEG:WeatherClimteRA ONL-UIUC, MS:WeatherClimteRA ONL-UIUC, NDEG:Environ Geology ONL-UIUC, MS:GIS & Data Sci ONL - UIUC, or NDEG:GIS & Data Sci ONL -UIUC.
